question: Use the full test suite in `tests/qa/testcase.py`, class `TestConditionsBuildCnfClosureDictSizeLoopInvariantSuiteQA` (23 tests). Across the entire test-suite execution, consider every Python `line` event of the inner closure whose `lineno == 139` (i.e., the moment immediately BEFORE the `equals[c_equal.hash] = c_equal` statement is executed). At every such event, is the loop invariant `len(equal_vars) == len(equals)` always held? Return JSON as `{\"invariant_exists\": <bool>}` where `true` means the invariant holds at every observed event and `false` means it does not.
